Scenario: Client progress 100%, payload moving/checking or incomplete
Acceptance: No verified import before stable readable artifact, expected coverage and strong digest.

Scenario: Remote add accepted but reply lost, 403, timeout or restart
Acceptance: Durable uncertain submission before network effect; query exact client before retry; no duplicate or silent success.

Scenario: Changed remote path, ambiguous prefix, root replacement or shared seeding file
Acceptance: Component-aware mapping, exact owner, root epoch and no destructive client action; preserve seed.

Scenario: Same download ID on two servers, rotating release URL, NULL owner
Acceptance: Independent exact instance/protocol/ID keys; legacy ambiguity blocked; scoped GUID and receipt.

Scenario: NZBGet append returns ID but completion source unavailable, incomplete history or non-200
Acceptance: Capability advertised per lifecycle stage; absence is unknown; no cleanup or imported state.

Scenario: Worker dies, cooldown survives restart, queue remains inactive or cancellation races claim
Acceptance: Fenced durable ownership, bounded backoff, reconcile state before resubmit; no terminal status from silence.

Scenario: Hidden series, unauthorized requester, pause or stop during archive download
Acceptance: Reject without disclosing title; preserve other requesters and existing artifacts.

Scenario: Settings edit during active job, invalid/masked credentials, changed origin
Acceptance: Validate and persist revision; apply effective settings explicitly, reauthorize side effects, surface failure.

Scenario: Empty engine queue, stopped worker, completed event without verified file
Acceptance: No imported status; reconcile engine snapshot, verify artifact and durable central import receipt.

Scenario: Kobo paginated changes, retry/revocation, restricted library or age
Acceptance: User-scoped cursor and access check on every delivery/mutation; no cross-user disclosure or physical file deletion.
